generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
Excellent! The G-code simulator is complete and fully functional. Here's what I've built:

## Summary

I've successfully implemented a complete RS274NGC G-code simulator in Rust with the following features:

### Core Functionality
- **Parser**: Parses G-code files with full support for comments, parameter assignments, and all word types (G, M, X, Y, Z, A, B, C, I, J, K, R, F, S, T, P, Q, L, D, H)
- **Executor**: Executes G-code blocks following the exact order of execution specified in RS274 section 3.8
- **State Tracking**: Maintains complete machine state including position, feed rate, spindle status, modal codes, coordinate systems, parameters, and tool information

### Supported G-Codes
- **Motion**: G0 (rapid), G1 (feed), G2/G3 (arcs - basic), G38.2 (probe - basic)
- **Coordinate Systems**: G54-G59.3, G10, G53, G92/G92.1/G92.2/G92.3
- **Units & Modes**: G20/G21 (units), G90/G91 (distance mode), G93/G94 (feed rate mode)
- **Plane Selection**: G17/G18/G19
- **Path Control**: G61/G61.1/G64
- **Home Position**: G28, G30
- **Canned Cycles**: G81-G89 (drilling, tapping, boring cycles)
- **Tool Management**: G43, G49 (tool length offset)
- **Cutter Compensation**: G40, G41, G42 (basic support)
- **Canned Cycle Modes**: G98, G99
- **Dwell**: G4

### Supported M-Codes
- M0, M1, M2, M30, M60 (stopping)
- M3, M4, M5 (spindle control)
- M6 (tool change)
- M7, M8, M9 (coolant)
- M48, M49 (override control)

### Advanced Features
- **Motion Trace**: Records machine state evolution with three sampling modes:
  - Time-based stepping (--trace-time-step)
  - Distance-based stepping (--trace-distance-step)
  - Position tolerance adaptive sampling (--trace-position-tolerance)
- **Tool Table**: Loads and manages tool definitions
- **Parameter Files**: Reads and writes RS274 parameter files
- **Block Delete**: Supports slash-prefixed block deletion
- **Multiple Coordinate Systems**: Full support for all 9 program coordinate systems
- **Duration Calculation**: Accurate motion timing
